statement: The retention record for BK-2021 gives “Legal retention: period over, cleared to purge,” but because the governing legal requirement is that BK-2021 must be kept until 31 December 2028, I am setting it to hold rather than purge.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record's "cleared to purge" contradicts the stated legal retention until 31 December 2028 and sets it to hold instead.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
